<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan online jewelry store selling silver and gold-plated rings, earrings, chains, pendants, bracelets and wedding bands, plus traditional silverwork and gift cards. Delivers in Montevideo and the interior.
